description: This Swift extension adds helper methods to the CanvasWindowController class to handle string sanitization, JSON string escaping, frame persistence, and UserDefaults interactions for window frames.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key string by trimming whitespace and replacing disallowed characters with underscores, defaulting to 'main' if empty.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Encodes a string as a JSON-compatible string literal, escaping special characters.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JSON string literal for an optional string, or 'null' if nil.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Generates a unique UserDefaults key for storing frame data based on sanitized session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a saved NSRect frame from UserDefaults if available and valid.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores an NSRect frame into UserDefaults under a key derived from the session key.
